paragraphs: Established in the year of 2006, we "VJ SECURITY" are known to be among the most eminent organizations involved in offering a broad array of Security and Manpower Services. Our provided range of services consists of Security Services, Personal Security Services and many more. We are providing these services with the help of well qualified and experienced professionals as per the client's requirements and needs. As we are offering a diverse array of services so we have recruited experts of each domain and these experts provide best and perfect services for our customers.

VJ security is now making your environment, your employees, your assets and your loved ones more secure so that you can focus on your core businesses. By understanding our responsibilities to this profession and society, we devote all our time for better understanding the market and the needs of our customers - both current and future and simultaneously design and develop better solutions with different value chains for various customer groups.

Under the assistance of our mentor Col Vikas Joshi (Retd), we are able to be a trusted and prominent organization of this domain in the short period of time. His vast industry experience and knowledge enable to serve our clients in the best manner.

SecurityServices1.desc: VJ Security provides comprehensive guarding, VIP protection, vehicle and event security, analysis, audits, consultancy, facilities management and manpower solutions.

services.title: Armed Guard Services
services.description: VJ Security is licensed to offer clients armed protective services. In response to changing requirements in the world of security, VJ Security has obtained a Firearms Business license. Experienced security guard staff who exhibit the exemplary qualities required to deliver armed services are routinely identified and encouraged to complete the Certificate of Proficiency in Firearms Training and the Authorization to Carry Firearms certificate.

services.title: Unarmed Guard Services
services.description: VJ Security Service specializes in premiere site & event security for a host of industries and applications. We guarantee the availability of a uniformed security guard either unarmed, armed or even an off duty officer anytime of the day 24/7. We make sure to go above and to make sure you get the right person for the right job.

services.title: Personal Security Officer Services
services.description: VJ Security is to deliver reliable VIP protection anywhere around the globe at a moment's notice. Our services range from providing one-time personal protection to developing long-term comprehensive personnel and asset protection. Our Personal Security Services offer a variety of solutions for protecting your employees, property and assets. Our personal security solutions are tailored.

services.title: Armed Marshal Services
services.description: Being one of the reputed organizations of the industry, we are offering an exclusive range of Security Services to our precious clients. These offered services are rendered using the modern technology under the supervision of skilled personnel. Arm Marshal Service is one of our modern technology service. These all services are useful for various places such as hospital, schools, industrial area...etc.

services.title: Vehicle Security Services
services.description: Backed by the vast industrial experience we are engaged in offering a qualitative range of Vehicle Security Services. These services are offered for vehicle protection. VJ Security services offers professional vehicle services with extensively trained security officers and has a distinguished reputation, so that our valued clients can avail these services in unique options as per their requirement.

services.title: Events Security Services
services.description: We are recognized for our security protection in high-profile events in the entertainment and sports sectors. VJ Security uses highly specialized, experienced personnel who partner with you to develop a comprehensive security plan tailored to your event's specific needs. From coordinating local law enforcement agencies and administrative authorities to planning for normal and worst case scenarios.

services.title: Security Analysis Services
services.description: The analysis of various tradable financial instruments is called security analysis. We are highly assessing in security analysing. We serve you the best as we want a long term relationship with our clients.

services.title: Security Audit Services
services.description: A Security Audit differs from a survey in that it is a process to assess whether an existing security system and procedures are operating to set of standards or criteria they were designed to. It evaluates the administration of the system, security awareness of employees, the management controls and compliance with standards. This is a valuable tool to give an accurate overview to the senior management.

services.title: Consultancy Service
services.description: VJ Security provides professional security consultancy to help clients plan safer operations, strengthen procedures and make informed protection decisions. Our consultancy approach supports dignitary visits, site planning and practical security frameworks aligned to your business needs.

services.title: Facilities Management
services.description: VJ Security delivers facility management solutions designed for seamless, disruption-free operations. We support infrastructure and workplace environments with disciplined manpower and processes so clients can focus on their core business with peace of mind.

services.title: Manpower Solution
services.description: Through trained and verified personnel, VJ Security provides manpower solutions aligned with industrial and organisational needs. We help clients deploy the right workforce for security and support roles with professional conduct and dependable coverage.

SecurityMission1.desc: At VJ Security, our mission, vision and goals reflect our dedication to creating safer environments for people, property and businesses through reliable security solutions and professional service.

items.title: Our Mission
items.description: To provide cutting-edge security solutions that ensure the safety, reliability and peace of mind of our clients. We are committed to innovation, excellence and building trust through professional and proactive security services.

items.title: Our Vision
items.description: To be a leading and most trusted security service provider, recognized for our integrity, technology-driven solutions and unwavering commitment to creating safer communities, workplaces and public spaces.

details.name: Arvind Sharma
details.biography: Arvind leads our security strategy and ensures every assignment is built around the safety of our clients and their people. With extensive experience in security operations, he oversees site assessments, service standards and incident readiness. He works closely with clients to understand their risks and translate them into practical plans. Arvind also supports and mentors our leadership team, building a culture of accountability, professionalism and calm decision-making. His focus is dependable protection and long-term client confidence.
highlights: Leads security strategy and operational standards
Oversees client risk assessments and protection plans
Guides incident response and escalation readiness
Mentors team leaders and security supervisors
Builds trusted relationships with clients

details.name: Priya Singh
details.biography: Priya coordinates the people and processes that keep our security services running smoothly every day. She manages assignments, schedules and operational communication so each client receives consistent coverage. Priya works with supervisors to address changing site requirements and makes sure teams have clear instructions before every shift. She is known for her organized approach, thoughtful problem-solving and steady support for both clients and colleagues. Her priority is reliable service with the right people in the right place.
highlights: Coordinates staffing and day-to-day assignments
Maintains dependable coverage across client sites
Communicates operational updates clearly
Supports supervisors with changing requirements
Monitors service quality and follow-through

details.name: Rakesh Kumar
details.biography: Rakesh supports frontline teams and helps ensure that site procedures are followed with care and consistency. He checks in with officers, reviews shift handovers and provides practical guidance when situations need attention. His hands-on approach helps identify small concerns before they become larger issues. Rakesh also keeps communication flowing between clients, guards and operations, making sure information reaches the right people. He takes pride in maintaining a professional, visible and dependable security presence.
highlights: Supervises guards and daily site routines
Checks shift handovers and assignment readiness
Reinforces client procedures and service standards
Escalates incidents through clear channels
Provides practical support to frontline officers

details.name: Ananya Sharma
details.biography: Ananya helps our security professionals build the knowledge and confidence they need to serve clients well. She coordinates onboarding and ongoing learning, with a focus on communication, awareness and responsible response. Ananya works with supervisors to identify useful coaching opportunities and keep training relevant to the environments our teams protect. She encourages a thoughtful, respectful approach to every interaction. Her work helps officers stay prepared, professional and ready to adapt to changing site needs.
highlights: Coordinates team onboarding and ongoing learning
Supports role-specific site briefings
Promotes clear communication and situational awareness
Works with supervisors on coaching needs
Encourages professional and respectful conduct

details.name: Vikram Yadav
details.biography: Vikram leads security teams on the ground, setting a positive example through consistency and professionalism. He makes sure officers understand their responsibilities, communicate effectively and provide a welcoming presence for clients and visitors. During each shift, Vikram monitors site activity and supports his team as priorities change. He believes strong teamwork and clear handovers are essential to dependable protection. His practical leadership helps create a secure and well-managed environment for everyone on site.
highlights: Leads and supports officers during assigned shifts
Sets clear expectations for site responsibilities
Promotes teamwork and reliable handovers
Monitors activity and raises concerns promptly
Maintains a professional presence for guests and clients

details.name: Meena Rawat
details.biography: Meena helps maintain awareness across monitored sites by handling information carefully and communicating it promptly. She supports control-room operations, keeps clear records and coordinates updates with field teams when attention is needed. Meena stays composed while managing multiple requests and follows established procedures to ensure important details are not missed. Her careful observation and dependable communication help strengthen our wider response. She is committed to providing attentive support around the clock.
highlights: Supports monitoring and control-room operations
Records important updates with care and accuracy
Coordinates timely communication with field teams
Follows established escalation procedures
Maintains calm focus across changing priorities

details.name: Suresh Verma
details.biography: Suresh carries out mobile patrols and site checks to help clients maintain a visible and responsive security presence. He follows agreed routes, pays close attention to entrances and boundaries, and records relevant observations from each visit. When he identifies an issue, Suresh communicates it through the appropriate channels so it can be addressed quickly. He approaches every assignment with care, punctuality and respect for the property he protects. His work helps clients feel informed and supported between on-site shifts.
highlights: Completes scheduled mobile patrols and site checks
Inspects agreed entrances, boundaries and key areas
Documents visits and notable observations
Reports concerns through clear escalation channels
Provides a punctual and visible security presence

details.name: Deepika Mishra
details.biography: Deepika is a key point of contact for clients, helping ensure questions and service requests receive thoughtful attention. She listens closely, shares updates with the appropriate teams and follows through so clients know what to expect. Her clear communication helps connect day-to-day site operations with each client's priorities. Deepika values responsive service and the trust built through consistent, respectful interactions. She works to make every client feel heard, informed and confident in their security support.
highlights: Builds clear and responsive client communication
Coordinates service requests with internal teams
Shares useful updates and follows through
Listens to client feedback and changing priorities
Strengthens long-term, trusted working relationships

SecurityFAQ1.desc: Find answers to common questions about our security guard services, staffing, training, and custom security solutions.

items.question: What types of security guard services do you provide?
items.answer: We provide a wide range of security guard services including commercial, residential, industrial, event, retail, construction site, and healthcare security. Our services are customized to meet the specific needs of each client.

items.question: Are your security guards trained and verified?
items.answer: Yes, all our security personnel undergo rigorous background checks, professional training, and verification procedures before deployment.

items.question: Can you provide security for short-term events?
items.answer: We offer flexible security guard staffing for corporate events, private parties, concerts, exhibitions, and short-term assignments.

items.question: Do you offer 24/7 security services?
items.answer: Yes, our security teams and monitoring centers operate round the clock to ensure uninterrupted protection for your premises.

items.question: What industries do you serve?
items.answer: We serve a wide variety of sectors including corporate offices, residential societies, industrial plants, healthcare facilities, and retail centers.

items.question: How do you ensure the quality of your security personnel?
items.answer: We maintain strict supervision, regular performance audits, ongoing training programs, and direct communication channels with our guards.

items.question: Can we request a customized security plan?
items.answer: Every property has unique risks. We conduct site assessments to build tailored security protocols specific to your operational requirements.

items.question: How do we get a quote for security services?
items.answer: You can reach out to us via our contact form, phone, or email to discuss your security needs and receive a transparent, competitive estimate.

SecurityRefund1.introBeforeLink: Thank you for choosing 2803 Vikas Joshi Security Agency (VJ Security Services) (
SecurityRefund1.introAfterLink: ). Please review our policy regarding service cancellations and refunds:
SecurityRefund1.companyBold: 2803 Vikas Joshi Security Agency (VJ Security Services)

items.title: Service Deployment Cancellation
items.content: Clients can request the cancellation of a security contract or guard deployment by providing a written notice at least 7 days before the scheduled deployment date.

items.title: How to Cancel
items.content: All cancellation requests must be sent via email to our official support address:
items.afterLink: . Phone cancellations will not be entertained.

items.title: Eligible Refunds
items.content: If a valid cancellation request is received and accepted within the 7-day notice period, the advance payment will be refunded after a minimal deduction of 10% administrative and processing charges.

items.title: Non-Refundable
items.content: No refunds will be provided under the following circumstances:
bullets: If the cancellation request is made less than 7 days before the deployment date.
For security guards or Personal Security Officers (PSOs) who have already been deployed at the site.
For services that have already been completed or partially rendered.

items.content: Once a refund request is approved by VJ Security management, the amount will be automatically credited back to the customer's original payment method (Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking) used during the transaction.
The refund will reflect in your account within 7 to 10 working days, depending on the banking partner's processing cycle.

meta.title: Shipping and Delivery Policy | VJ Security
meta.description: Shipping and delivery policy for VJ Security service deployments.

paragraphs.beforeLink: At 2803 Vikas Joshi Security Agency (VJ Security Services) (
paragraphs.afterLink: ), we specialize in providing professional security solutions, including Security Guards, Personal Security Officers (PSOs), Event Security, and Safety Management Services. As a service-based organization, we do not manufacture, sell, or deliver any physical products.
paragraphs.companyBold: 2803 Vikas Joshi Security Agency (VJ Security Services)

paragraphs.text: Since our business is entirely service-oriented, there are no physical goods, packages, or products that require shipping, courier, or logistics services. Therefore, conventional shipping and delivery policies are not applicable.

Once the service agreement has been finalized, the required documentation has been completed, and the agreed advance payment has been received, our team will initiate the deployment process. Security personnel will be assigned and deployed to the client's specified location on the mutually agreed date and time.
